title: Zamonlar tizimi: umumiy takrorlash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilidagi barcha asosiy zamonlarni bitta xaritada ko‘rasiz, vaqt belgilariga va ma’noga qarab to‘g‘ri zamonni tanlaysiz hamda 120 so‘zli matnda kamida beshta zamonni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.

scenes.title: B1 darajasiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say: Welcome to B1! Today we will put all the English tenses on one map and learn to choose the right one by meaning.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum va yangi bosqich — B1 darajasiga xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda A2 yakuniy imtihonini topshirdik, endi o‘rta darajadamiz. Bugun ingliz tilidagi barcha zamonlarni bitta xaritada ko‘ramiz, har birining vaqt belgilarini eslaymiz va eng muhimi — zamonni tarjimaga emas, ma’noga qarab tanlashni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida beshta turli zamondan foydalanib, o‘zingiz haqingizda qisqa hikoya aytib bera olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bu darsda barcha zamonlarni bitta xaritaga joylab, to‘g‘risini ma’no bo‘yicha tanlashni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Zamonlar xaritasi
board: Present: work | am working | have worked | have been working
Past: worked | was working | had worked
Future: will work | am going to work | am working (plan)
scenes.say: Every English verb form answers two questions. First: when? Past, present or future. Second: how do we see the action? As a simple fact, as something in progress, or as something connected to another time.
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilidagi har bir fe’l shakli ikkita savolga javob beradi. Birinchisi — qachon? O‘tgan, hozirgi yoki kelasi vaqt. Ikkinchisi — harakatga qanday qaraymiz? Oddiy fakt sifatida, davom etayotgan jarayon sifatida yoki ikki vaqt o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlik sifatida. Shu ikki savolni berish odatini yodlab oling: butun xarita shundan iborat. Zamonlar o‘nlab emas, mantiqli tizim.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir shakl ikki savolga javob beradi: qachon bo‘lgan va harakatga qanday qaraymiz.

scenes.title: Present: simple va continuous
board: Present continuous: hozir / shu kunlarda, vaqtinchalik

examples.t: I work in a bank.
I'm working from home this week.
The shop opens at nine.

scenes.say: I work in a bank. But this week I'm working from home. The shop opens at nine.
scenes.say_native: Hozirgi zamonning ikki asosiy shakli bor. Present simple — odat, doimiy fakt va jadval uchun. Present continuous — hozir yoki shu kunlarda davom etayotgan, vaqtinchalik harakat uchun. O‘zbekchada ikkalasi ham “-man” va “-yapman” bilan ajraladi, shuning uchun bu juftlik sizga tanish. Faqat inglizchada tanlash majburiy: bank xodimi bo‘lish — simple, bu hafta uyda ishlash — continuous.
scenes.say_uz: Men bankda ishlayman. Lekin bu hafta uyda ishlayapman. Do‘kon soat to‘qqizda ochiladi.

scenes.title: Past: simple va continuous
board: Past continuous: o‘tmishda davom etgan jarayon

examples.t: I watched a film last night.
I was watching a film at nine.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
examples.uz: Uyga piyoda ketayotganimda yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

scenes.say: I watched a film last night. At nine o'clock I was watching it. I was walking home when it started to rain.
scenes.say_native: O‘tgan zamonda ham ikki shakl. Past simple — tugagan, qisqa yoki butun voqea: “I watched a film”. Past continuous — o‘tmishdagi aniq paytda davom etayotgan jarayon, ko‘pincha fon sifatida: “I was walking home”. Qisqa voqea esa shu fonni to‘xtatadi va past simple bilan aytiladi: yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha film ko‘rdim. Soat to‘qqizda uni ko‘rayotgan edim. Uyga ketayotganimda yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

scenes.title: Perfect shakllar: qisqa ko‘rinish
board: Present perfect continuous: have been + V-ing

examples.t: I've finished my report.
I've been working since eight.
The film had started when we arrived.
examples.uz: Biz kelganimizda film boshlanib bo‘lgan edi.

scenes.say: I've finished my report. I've been working since eight. When we arrived, the film had already started.
scenes.say_native: Perfect shakllar ikki vaqtni bog‘laydi. Present perfect o‘tmishdagi voqeani hozir bilan bog‘laydi: hisobot tayyor. Present perfect continuous — o‘tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayon. Past perfect esa o‘tmishdagi ikki voqeadan avvalgisi: biz kelgunimizcha film boshlangan edi.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni tugatdim. Sakkizdan beri ishlayapman. Biz kelganimizda film allaqachon boshlangan edi.

scenes.title: Kelasi zamon: uch yo‘l
board: will + V: shu zahoti qaror, taxmin, va’da
be going to + V: reja yoki dalilga asoslangan taxmin

examples.t: I'll call you later.
I'm going to study medicine.
We're meeting at six.

scenes.say: I'll call you later. I'm going to study medicine. We're meeting at six tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: Inglizchada kelasi zamon uchun bitta “future tense” yo‘q, uchta asosiy yo‘l bor. “Will” — gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror, taxmin yoki va’da. “Be going to” — oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat yoki ko‘z oldingizdagi dalilga asoslangan taxmin. Present continuous — vaqti va joyi kelishilgan uchrashuv.
scenes.say_uz: Keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Men tibbiyotda o‘qimoqchiman. Ertaga soat oltida uchrashamiz.

scenes.title: Qaysi zamon?
board: 2) They were having dinner at nine.
scenes.say: Name the tense. Number one: she has lived here since 2015. Number two: they were having dinner at nine. Number three: I'll help you. Number four: we had already eaten.
scenes.say_native: Har bir gap qaysi zamonda ekanini nomi bilan ayting. Eslatma: avval “qachon?” deb so‘rang, keyin “qanday ko‘ramiz?” deb so‘rang. Masalan, birinchi gapda “since 2015” bor — o‘tmishda boshlangan, hozir ham davom etayotgan holat.
scenes.say_uz: Zamonni ayting. Bir: u 2015 yildan beri shu yerda yashaydi. Ikki: ular soat to‘qqizda kechki ovqat qilayotgan edi. Uch: sizga yordam beraman. To‘rt: biz allaqachon ovqatlangan edik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: present perfect. Two: past continuous. Three: future with will. Four: past perfect.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — present perfect: have/has va V3, “since” bilan. Ikki — past continuous: were having, o‘tmishdagi aniq paytda jarayon. Uch — will bilan kelasi zamon, shu zahoti taklif qilingan yordam. To‘rt — past perfect: had eaten, boshqa o‘tmish voqeasidan oldin tugagan.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: present perfect. Ikki: past continuous. Uch: will bilan kelasi zamon. To‘rt: past perfect.

scenes.title: Hozirgi zamon belgilari
board: Simple: always, usually, often, never, every day
Continuous: now, at the moment, these days, today
Faqat belgi emas, ma’no hal qiladi

examples.t: She usually walks to work.
Today she's taking the bus.
Look! It's raining.

scenes.say: She usually walks to work, but today she's taking the bus. Look, it's raining!
scenes.say_native: Endi vaqt belgilari — zamon tanlashdagi ishonchli yo‘l-yo‘riqlar. Present simple bilan: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day. Present continuous bilan: now, at the moment, these days, today, this week. Lekin belgi faqat yordamchi. “Look!” va “Listen!” kabi so‘zlar ham hozir davom etayotgan harakatni ko‘rsatadi va continuous talab qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: U odatda ishga piyoda boradi, lekin bugun avtobusda ketyapti. Qarang, yomg‘ir yog‘yapti!

scenes.title: O‘tgan zamon belgilari
board: Past simple: yesterday, last week, ago, in 2019, when I was a child
Past continuous: at 8 o'clock last night, while, all evening
Past perfect: by the time, before, already (o‘tmishda)

examples.t: I met her three years ago.
examples.uz: Men u bilan uch yil oldin tanishganman.

examples.t: While I was cooking, he called.
examples.uz: Men ovqat tayyorlayotganimda u qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

examples.t: By the time I arrived, she had left.
examples.uz: Men yetib kelgunimcha, u ketib bo‘lgan edi.

scenes.say: I met her three years ago. While I was cooking, he called. By the time I arrived, she had left.
scenes.say_native: O‘tgan zamon belgilari. Past simple bilan aniq tugagan vaqt keladi: yesterday, last week, three years ago, in 2019, when I was a child. Past continuous bilan: at eight o‘clock last night, while, all evening. Past perfect bilan: by the time, before, already — ya’ni boshqa o‘tmish nuqtasidan oldin. “Ago” so‘zini yodda tuting: u doim past simple bilan ishlatiladi, boshqa zamon bilan emas.
scenes.say_uz: Men u bilan uch yil oldin tanishganman. Men ovqat tayyorlayotganimda u qo‘ng‘iroq qildi. Men yetib kelgunimcha u ketib bo‘lgan edi.

scenes.title: Perfect belgilari
board: already, yet, just, ever, never, so far, recently
Hali tugamagan davr: this week, today, this year

examples.t: Have you ever been to London?
I haven't finished yet.
We've lived here for ten years / since 2015.
examples.uz: Biz bu yerda o‘n yildan beri / 2015 yildan beri yashaymiz.

scenes.say: Have you ever been to London? I haven't finished yet. We've lived here for ten years, since 2015.
scenes.say_native: Present perfect uchun tipik belgilar: already, yet, just, ever, never, so far, recently. Shuningdek “for” va “since”. “For” bilan muddat aytamiz — for ten years. “Since” bilan boshlanish nuqtasi — since 2015. Yana muhim: hali tugamagan vaqt bo‘lagi — this week, today, this year — ham perfect bilan keladi. O‘zbekchada bu yerda hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi, shuning uchun xatolar shu yerda ko‘p.
scenes.say_uz: Siz hech Londonda bo‘lganmisiz? Men hali tugatganim yo‘q. Biz bu yerda o‘n yildan beri, 2015 yildan beri yashaymiz.

scenes.title: Kelasi zamon belgilari
board: tomorrow, next week, soon, tonight, in two days
probably, I think, I expect + will

examples.t: I think it will rain tomorrow.
She's flying to Dubai next week.
I'll see you in two days.

scenes.say: I think it will rain tomorrow. She's flying to Dubai next week. I'll see you in two days.
scenes.say_native: Kelasi zamon belgilari: tomorrow, next week, soon, tonight, in two days. Diqqat: “in two days” kelasi zamonda “ikki kundan keyin” degani, o‘tgan zamondagi “two days ago” esa “ikki kun oldin”. “Probably”, “I think”, “I expect” kabi so‘zlar taxmin bildirib, odatda will bilan keladi. Aniq kelishilgan reja — masalan, reys chiptasi olingan bo‘lsa — present continuous bilan aytiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘adi. U kelasi hafta Dubayga uchadi. Ikki kundan keyin ko‘rishamiz.

scenes.title: Belgi va zamon mos kelmasa
board: ✗ I saw him two years ago and I have known him since.  → ✓ I've known him for two years.
scenes.say: Not: I have seen him yesterday. Say: I saw him yesterday. Yesterday is finished time, so we use the past simple.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: aniq tugagan vaqt belgisini present perfect bilan aralashtirish. “I have seen him yesterday” — noto‘g‘ri, chunki “yesterday” butunlay o‘tib ketgan aniq vaqt. To‘g‘risi: “I saw him yesterday”. Qoida shunday: yesterday, last week, ago, in 2019 kabi so‘zlar bilan faqat past simple. O‘zbekcha “kecha ko‘rganman” desak bo‘ladi, inglizchada esa mumkin emas.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I have seen him yesterday. To‘g‘risi: I saw him yesterday. Kecha — tugagan vaqt, shuning uchun past simple.

scenes.title: Zamonni tanlang
scenes.say: Complete the sentences. One: I, see, him yesterday. Two: she, live, here since 2015. Three: what, you, do, at eight last night? Four: they, not finish, yet.
scenes.say_native: Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklda qo‘ying. Har bir gapda vaqt belgisiga qarang: “yesterday” nimani talab qiladi? “Since 2015-chi”? “At eight last night”? Va “yet” qaysi zamonga xos? Javobni baland ovozda ayting, keyin tekshiramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni to‘ldiring. Bir: kecha uni ko‘rdim. Ikki: u 2015 yildan beri shu yerda yashaydi. Uch: kecha soat sakkizda nima qilayotgan eding? To‘rt: ular hali tugatmagan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: saw. Two: has lived. Three: were you doing. Four: haven't finished.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “saw”, chunki yesterday tugagan vaqt. Ikki — “has lived”, chunki since 2015 hozirgacha davom etadi. Uch — “were you doing”, kecha soat sakkizdagi jarayon. To‘rt — “haven’t finished”, chunki “yet” present perfect inkor gapida keladi. To‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, vaqt belgilarini ishlatishga tayyorsiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: saw. Ikki: has lived. Uch: were you doing. To‘rt: haven't finished.

scenes.title: Eshiting: eski do‘st bilan uchrashuv
board: A: Ali! I haven't seen you for ages.
B: I moved to Samarkand in March.
B: Last week it started to rain while I was showing tourists the Registan.
B: Next month I'm going to organise my own tour.
scenes.say: Hi Ali, I haven't seen you for ages! What have you been doing? I moved to Samarkand in March, and now I work for a travel company. Last week it started to rain while I was showing tourists the Registan! We ran into a café. Next month I'm going to organise my own tour.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Ikki eski do‘st ko‘cha-da uchrashib qolishdi. Eshitganingizda zamonlarga e’tibor bering: present perfect, past simple, present simple, past continuous va going to — hammasi bitta suhbatda. Bu odatiy hol: real nutqda zamonlar doim aralashib ketadi va har biri o‘z ma’nosi uchun ishlatiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Salom Ali, seni ming yildan beri ko‘rmadim! Nima qilib yurdingiz? Martda Samarqandga ko‘chib o‘tdim, hozir sayohat kompaniyasida ishlayman. O‘tgan hafta turistlarga Registonni ko‘rsatayotganimda yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi! Kafega yugurib kirdik. Kelasi oy o‘z turimni tashkil qilmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Tushundingizmi?
board: 1) When did Ali move to Samarkand?
3) What was he doing when it started to rain?
4) What is he going to do next month?
scenes.say: Four questions. When did Ali move to Samarkand? Where does he work now? What was he doing when it started to rain? What is he going to do next month?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Javob berishdan oldin savolning zamoniga qarang: “did” — o‘tgan, “does” — hozirgi, “was doing” — jarayon, “is going to” — reja. Javobingiz ham shu zamonga mos bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. Ali Samarqandga qachon ko‘chib o‘tdi? U hozir qayerda ishlaydi? Yomg‘ir yog‘a boshlaganda u nima qilayotgan edi? Kelasi oy nima qilmoqchi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) He was showing tourists the Registan.
4) He's going to organise his own tour.
scenes.say: In March. He works for a travel company. He was showing tourists the Registan. He's going to organise his own tour.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — martda. Ikki — u sayohat kompaniyasida ishlaydi. Uch — u turistlarga Registonni ko‘rsatayotgan edi. To‘rt — u kelasi oy o‘z turini tashkil qilmoqchi. Maqsadimiz — ularning har birini ma’nosiga qarab tanlay olish.
scenes.say_uz: Martda. U sayohat kompaniyasida ishlaydi. U turistlarga Registonni ko‘rsatayotgan edi. U o‘z turini tashkil qilmoqchi.

scenes.title: Ma’noga qarab tanlash
scenes.say: Do not translate word by word. Ask three questions. When did it happen? Is it finished or in progress? Does it connect to now?
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim ko‘nikma: tarjimaga emas, ma’noga qarab tanlash. O‘zbekcha “men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman” desak, fe’l hozirgi zamonda turadi. Agar ingliz tiliga so‘zma-so‘z o‘girsak, “I live” chiqadi, lekin to‘g‘risi “I’ve lived”. Shuning uchun uch savol: qachon bo‘lgan? Tugaganmi yoki davom etyaptimi? Hozirgi payt bilan bog‘liqmi? Shu savollar zamonni o‘zi aytib beradi.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang. Uchta savol bering: qachon bo‘lgan? Tugaganmi yoki davom etyaptimi? Hozirga bog‘liqmi?

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha shakl va inglizcha zamon

examples.t: Men ishlayapman.
Men ishladim.
Men ishlaganman.

scenes.say: Uzbek and English tenses overlap, but not exactly. Use Uzbek only as a hint, never as a rule.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida ham zamon shakllari bor va ular ingliz tiliga qisman mos keladi. “-yapman” ko‘pincha continuous’ga, “-di” past simple’ga, “-gan” esa ko‘pincha perfect’ga to‘g‘ri keladi. Lekin bu faqat ishora, qoida emas. “Besh yildan beri yashayman” hozirgi zamon, inglizchasi esa perfect. Shuning uchun o‘z tilingizdagi shaklga ishonmay, ma’no savollariga tayaning.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbek va ingliz zamonlari qisman mos keladi. O‘zbekchani faqat ishora sifatida ishlating, qoida sifatida emas.

scenes.title: Hikoya qanday quriladi
scenes.say: It was raining and I was waiting for the bus. I had forgotten my umbrella, so I got wet. Events, background, earlier events.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya aytganda zamonlar rollarga bo‘linadi. Voqealar ketma-ketligi — past simple: “I got wet”. Fon, ya’ni o‘sha payt nima bo‘layotgani — past continuous: yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi. Oldinroq sodir bo‘lgan sabab — past perfect: soyabonni unutgan edim. Shu uch rolni bilsangiz, har qanday o‘tmish hikoyasini aniq qura olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi va men avtobus kutardim. Soyabonni unutgan edim, shuning uchun ho‘l bo‘ldim.

scenes.title: Simple yoki continuous?
board: Simple: odat, doimiy fakt, butun voqea
He is rude. ≠ He is being rude.

examples.t: My brother lives in Bukhara.
He's living with us at the moment.
examples.uz: U hozir bizning uyimizda yashab turibdi (vaqtinchalik).

examples.t: I read the whole book yesterday.

scenes.say: My brother lives in Bukhara, but he's living with us at the moment. Yesterday I read the whole book.
scenes.say_native: Simple va continuous orasidagi tanlov — ma’no tanlovi. Doimiy holat va odat — simple: akam Buxoroda yashaydi. Vaqtinchalik holat — continuous: u hozir bizda yashab turibdi. Yana bir nozik farq: butun voqea simple, jarayon continuous. “Yesterday I read the whole book” — kitob tugagan. “I was reading a book” desam, tugatganim-tugatmaganim noma’lum.
scenes.say_uz: Akam Buxoroda yashaydi, lekin hozir bizning uyimizda yashab turibdi. Kecha kitobning hammasini o‘qib chiqdim.

scenes.title: Holat fe’llari
board: state verbs: know, like, love, want, need, believe, understand

examples.t: I understand the rule.
She wants a coffee.
They love this city.

scenes.say: I understand the rule. She wants a coffee. They love this city. We do not say: I am understanding.
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi fe’llar jarayonni emas, holatni bildiradi: know, like, love, want, need, believe, understand, prefer. Ular odatda continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi. “I am knowing” yoki “I am wanting” deyish xato. O‘zbekchada “tushunyapman” desak bo‘ladi, inglizchada esa faqat “I understand”. Bir istisno bor: “I’m loving it” kabi reklama iboralari norasmiy, shuning uchun o‘rganmang, faqat tanib oling.
scenes.say_uz: Men qoidani tushunaman. U kofe xohlaydi. Ular bu shaharni yaxshi ko‘radi. “I am understanding” deb aytmaymiz.

scenes.title: Past simple va present perfect
board: Past simple: tugagan vaqt aniq yoki nazarda tutilgan
Present perfect: vaqt muhim emas, natija hozir bor
I lost my keys. / I've lost my keys.

examples.t: I lost my keys yesterday.
I've lost my keys — I can't get in.
I've never been to Japan.

scenes.say: I lost my keys yesterday. But now: I've lost my keys, and I can't get in. I've never been to Japan.
scenes.say_native: Past simple tugagan voqeani aytadi, odatda vaqti ma’lum. Present perfect esa vaqtni aytmaydi — muhim narsa natija yoki tajriba hozir ham mavjudligi. “I’ve lost my keys” desam, kalitlar hozir ham yo‘q. “I lost my keys yesterday” desam, hikoya o‘tmishda qolgan. Keyingi darsda aynan shu farqni, ya’ni tugallangan zamon va tajribani batafsil mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha kalitlarimni yo‘qotdim. Endi esa kalitlarimni yo‘qotib qo‘ydim va kira olmayapman. Men hech qachon Yaponiyada bo‘lmaganman.

scenes.title: Past continuous va past perfect
board: Jarayon + qisqa voqea: was doing + did
Ikki o‘tmish: oldin had done, keyin did
When I arrived, she was cooking / she had cooked.

examples.t: When I arrived, she was cooking.
examples.uz: Men kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

examples.t: When I arrived, she had cooked dinner.
examples.uz: Men kelganimda u kechki ovqatni pishirib bo‘lgan edi.

examples.t: When I arrived, she cooked dinner.
examples.uz: Men kelganimdan keyin u ovqat pishirdi.

scenes.say: When I arrived, she was cooking. When I arrived, she had cooked dinner. Different tense, different meaning!
scenes.say_native: Zamon ma’noni o‘zgartiradi. “When I arrived, she was cooking” — kelganimda ovqat pishirayotgan edi, jarayon o‘rtasi. “When I arrived, she had cooked dinner” — kelganimda ovqat allaqachon tayyor edi. “When I arrived, she cooked dinner” — avval kelganman, keyin u pishirgan. Uchta gap, uchta ma’no. O‘zbek tilida bu farqlar kontekstdan chiqadi, inglizchada esa zamon aytib turadi.
scenes.say_uz: Men kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi. Men kelganimda u ovqatni pishirib bo‘lgan edi. Zamon boshqa — ma’no boshqa!

scenes.title: Ma’noga qarab tanlang
board: 2) When we got there, the match ___ (start).
scenes.say: Choose by meaning. One: I, read, when the phone rang. Two: when we got there, the match, start. Three: she, study, English for two years. Four: wait! I, help, you.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni ma’noga qarab to‘ldiring. Birinchisida jarayon va qisqa voqea bor. Ikkinchisida ikki o‘tmish voqeasidan qaysi biri oldin bo‘lgan? Uchinchisida “for two years” va hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat. To‘rtinchisida shu zahoti qaror. Zamonni ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’noga qarab tanlang. Bir: telefon jiringlaganda o‘qiyotgan edim. Ikki: biz yetib borganda o‘yin boshlangan edi. Uch: u ikki yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganadi. To‘rt: kuting! Sizga yordam beraman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: was reading. Two: had started. Three: has been studying. Four: I'll help.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “was reading”: jarayon, telefon uni to‘xtatdi. Ikki — “had started”: o‘yin biz yetib borishimizdan oldin boshlangan. Uch — “has been studying” yoki “has studied”, ikkalasi ham mumkin: ikki yildan beri davom etadigan holat. To‘rt — “I’ll help”: shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: was reading. Ikki: had started. Uch: has been studying. To‘rt: I'll help.

scenes.title: Vaqtli gaplarda kelasi zamon
board: when, as soon as, before, after, until + PRESENT

examples.t: When I arrive, I'll call you.
As soon as she finishes, we'll leave.
If it rains, we'll stay at home.

scenes.say: When I arrive, I'll call you. As soon as she finishes, we'll leave. If it rains, we'll stay at home.
scenes.say_native: Kelasi zamonda bir muhim istisno: when, as soon as, before, after, until va if so‘zlaridan keyin will ishlatilmaydi, o‘rniga hozirgi zamon qo‘yiladi. O‘zbekchada “yetib borsam”, “yetib borganimda” desak, ham kelasi ma’no beradi, ham fe’l shakli kelasi. Inglizchada esa “When I will arrive” xato. To‘g‘risi “When I arrive”. Will faqat asosiy gapga qo‘yiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Yetib borganimda sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. U tugatishi bilan jo‘naymiz. Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tilidan o‘tgan xatolar: for / since
board: ✗ I live here for five years.
✓ I've lived here for five years.
✗ I am living here since 2019. → ✓ I've lived here since 2019.
scenes.say: Not: I live here for five years. Say: I've lived here for five years, or, since 2019.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi katta xato: “for” yoki “since” bilan hozirgi zamon ishlatish. O‘zbek tilida “besh yildan beri yashayman” — hozirgi zamon. Shuning uchun ko‘pchilik “I live here for five years” deydi. Bu xato. Hozirgacha davom etgan muddat uchun present perfect kerak: “I’ve lived here for five years” yoki “since 2019”. “Since” dan keyin yil, oy yoki vaqt nuqtasi, “for” dan keyin muddat turadi.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I live here for five years. To‘g‘risi: bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman, yoki 2019 yildan beri.

scenes.title: Holat fe’llari va will
board: ✗ When I will see him, I'll tell him. → ✓ When I see him, I'll tell him.
scenes.say: Not: I am knowing the answer. Say: I know the answer. And not: when I will see him. Say: when I see him.
scenes.say_native: Yana ikki xato. Birinchisi — “know”, “want”, “like” kabi holat fe’llarini continuous shaklda ishlatish: “I am knowing” emas, “I know”. Ikkinchisi — when, if, as soon as bilan will qo‘llash: “When I will see him” emas, “When I see him, I’ll tell him”. Ikkalasi ham o‘zbek tilidan o‘tadi, chunki unda bunday cheklov yo‘q. Shuning uchun bu ikki qoidani maxsus eslab qoling.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I am knowing. To‘g‘risi: I know. Noto‘g‘ri: When I will see him. To‘g‘risi: When I see him, I'll tell him.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 3) When I will get home, I'll cook.
4) Last year I have visited Rome.
scenes.say: Find and correct the mistake. One: I am wanting some tea. Two: I know her since 2018. Three: when I will get home, I'll cook. Four: last year I have visited Rome.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda bittadan xato bor. Har birini tuzating va nega xato ekanini ayting. Hint: birinchisi holat fe’li, ikkinchisi “since”, uchinchisi when va will, to‘rtinchisi “last year” bilan perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Xatoni toping va tuzating. Bir: choy xohlayman. Ikki: uni 2018 yildan beri bilaman. Uch: uyga kelganimda ovqat pishiraman. To‘rt: o‘tgan yili Rimga borganman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) When I get home, I'll cook.
scenes.say: One: I want some tea. Two: I've known her since 2018. Three: when I get home, I'll cook. Four: last year I visited Rome.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “I want some tea”, holat fe’li simple. Ikki — “I’ve known her since 2018”, chunki since hozirgacha davom etadi. Uch — “When I get home”, vaqtli gapda will yo‘q. To‘rt — “I visited Rome”, chunki “last year” tugagan vaqt.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: I want some tea. Ikki: I've known her since 2018. Uch: When I get home, I'll cook. To‘rt: Last year I visited Rome.

scenes.title: Qisqartmalar va kuchsiz shakllar
scenes.say: In fast speech, English tenses sound short. I've, she's, we'd, they'll. The helping verbs are weak: have is just /əv/, was is /wəz/, been is /bɪn/.
scenes.say_native: Ingliz nutqida yordamchi fe’llar juda qisqa aytiladi. “I have” — “I’ve”, “she is” yoki “she has” — “she’s”, “we would” yoki “we had” — “we’d”. Kuchsiz shakllarda “have” — /əv/, “was” — /wəz/, “been” — /bɪn/. Shuning uchun “I’ve been waiting” tez gapda “aiv bin weiting” kabi eshitiladi. Eshitish uchun bu juda muhim: zamonni asosan shu qisqa yordamchi so‘zlardan taniysiz.
scenes.say_uz: Tez nutqda inglizcha zamonlar qisqa eshitiladi. Yordamchi fe’llar kuchsiz aytiladi: have — /əv/, was — /wəz/, been — /bɪn/.

scenes.title: Qisqa aytib ko‘ring
scenes.say: I've been waiting. She was working. We'd already left. They'll be late.
scenes.say_native: Gaplarni takrorlang. Urg‘u mazmunli so‘zlarga tushadi: “waiting”, “working”, “left”, “late”. Yordamchi fe’llarni deyarli yutib yuboring. Masalan, “I’ve been waiting” da faqat “WAIT” baland. Sekin emas, ritm bilan ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang: kutib turibman. U ishlayotgan edi. Biz allaqachon ketgan edik. Ular kech qoladi.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri ritm
board: Urg‘u: mazmunli so‘zlar (waiting, working, left, late)
Kuchsiz: I've been, she was, we'd, they'll
scenes.say: Stress the content words: I've been WAITing. She was WORking. We'd already LEFT. They'll be LATE.
scenes.say_native: Tekshirib ko‘ring. Urg‘u mazmunli so‘zlarga: WAITing, WORking, LEFT, LATE. Yordamchi fe’llar esa pastroq va tezroq. Agar siz har bir so‘zni bir xil kuch bilan aytgan bo‘lsangiz, bu o‘zbek tilining ritmi ta’siri, bu normal. Ingliz tilida esa kuchli va kuchsiz so‘zlar almashib turadi.
scenes.say_uz: Mazmunli so‘zlarga urg‘u bering: waiting, working, left, late.

scenes.title: Eshiting: telefon suhbati
board: Mum: Where are you? Dinner's ready.
Tom: I've been in a meeting since three.
Tom: I didn't have lunch. I was too busy.
Tom: I'll be home at eight.
scenes.say: Where are you? Dinner's ready. Sorry, Mum. I've been in a meeting since three, and I haven't finished yet. I didn't have lunch, I was too busy. I'll be home at eight. Don't worry, we've already eaten, but I'll keep some for you.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: ona o‘g‘liga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoqda. Tom hali ishda. Tinglang va qaysi zamonlar ishlatilganiga qarang: present perfect since bilan, present perfect inkor yet bilan, past simple, will va yana present perfect. Barcha belgilar bu yerda: since, yet, already.
scenes.say_uz: Qayerdasan? Kechki ovqat tayyor. Kechir, ona. Soat uchdan beri yig‘ilishdaman va hali tugamadi. Tushlik qilmadim, juda band edim. Soat sakkizda uyda bo‘laman. Xavotir olma, biz allaqachon ovqatlandik, lekin senga olib qo‘yaman.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 2) How long has he been in a meeting?
scenes.say: Four questions. Where is Tom? How long has he been in a meeting? Why didn't he have lunch? When will he be home?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Tom qayerda? U qancha vaqtdan beri yig‘ilishda? Nega tushlik qilmadi? Qachon uyda bo‘ladi? Javobingizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting va zamoniga e’tibor bering: ikkinchi savolda “since three” kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. Tom qayerda? U qancha vaqtdan beri yig‘ilishda? Nega tushlik qilmadi? Qachon uyda bo‘ladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: He's at work, in a meeting. He's been there since three. He was too busy. He'll be home at eight.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — u ishda, yig‘ilishda. Ikki — soat uchdan beri, “since three o’clock”. Uch — u juda band edi, “he was too busy”. To‘rt — soat sakkizda. Ko‘rdingizmi: savolning zamoni javobning zamonini belgilaydi. “Since three” — present perfect, “was too busy” — past simple, “will be” — kelasi zamon.
scenes.say_uz: U ishda, yig‘ilishda. Soat uchdan beri o‘sha yerda. U juda band edi. Soat sakkizda uyda bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi uchun namuna
board: Past → Present perfect → Present → Past continuous → Future
Bog‘lovchilar: then, so, but, because, while
scenes.say: Last year I moved to Tashkent. Since then I've been studying English. I work in a shop now. While I was serving a customer yesterday, an English tourist asked me for directions. Next year I'm going to travel to London.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna matn. Beshta zamon: moved — past simple, have been studying — present perfect continuous, work — present simple, was serving — past continuous, going to travel — kelasi zamon. Gaplarni bog‘lovchilar bilan ulang: since then, while, so. Matn hayotingizdan bo‘lsin: shunda xotirada qoladi va tabiiy chiqadi. Hammasi 120 so‘zga yaqin bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili Toshkentga ko‘chib o‘tdim. O‘shandan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapman. Hozir do‘konda ishlayman. Kecha mijozga xizmat ko‘rsatayotganimda ingliz turisti yo‘l so‘radi. Kelasi yil Londonga sayohat qilmoqchiman.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz gapiring
board: 1) Where you lived / what you did last year
3) What you do now + what you're doing this week
scenes.say: Your turn. Speak for thirty seconds about yourself. Use four or five different tenses.
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. O‘ttiz soniya davomida o‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring. Doskadagi reja bo‘yicha: o‘tgan yili nima qilgan edingiz, so‘nggi paytda nima qilyapsiz, hozir nima ish qilasiz va bu hafta nimani boshqacha qilyapsiz, bitta rejangiz. Kamida to‘rtta turli zamon ishlating. Xato bo‘lsa to‘xtamang, davom eting.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. O‘ttiz soniya o‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring, to‘rt-besh xil zamon ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Last year I started a new job.
I've been learning English for six months.
I work in an office and this week I'm working from home.
Next summer I'm going to visit Turkey.
scenes.say: Last year I started a new job. I've been learning English for six months. I work in an office, and this week I'm working from home. Next summer I'm going to visit Turkey.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob mana. Past simple, present perfect continuous, present simple, present continuous va going to. O‘zingizning javobingizda ham shu zamonlar bo‘lganmi? Agar bo‘lmasa, hozir yana bir marta ayting.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili yangi ishga kirdim. Olti oydan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapman. Ofisda ishlayman, bu hafta esa uyda ishlayapman. Kelasi yozda Turkiyaga bormoqchiman.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Xatolar: for/since, state verbs, when + will
scenes.say: Today we built the tense map. Ask: when, and how do I see the action? Check the time markers. Watch for the three mistakes: for and since, state verbs, and will after when.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Bir: zamon ikki savoldan iborat: qachon va qanday ko‘ramiz. Ikki: har bir zamonning vaqt belgilari bor, lekin ma’no hal qiladi. Uch: ma’noga qarab tanlash, tarjimaga qarab emas. To‘rt: o‘zbek tilidan o‘tadigan uchta xato — for va since bilan hozirgi zamon, holat fe’llari continuous’da va when dan keyin will. Shularni eslab qolsangiz, B1 poydevori mustahkam.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun zamonlar xaritasini tuzdik. Qachon va qanday ko‘rishni so‘rang. Belgilarga qarang. Uchta xatoga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say: Your homework: write a text of about one hundred and twenty words about your life. Use at least five different tenses, then underline and name each one.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz haqingizda taxminan yuz yigirma so‘zdan iborat matn yozing. Unda kamida beshta turli zamon bo‘lsin, masalan past simple, present perfect, present simple, past continuous va kelasi zamon. Matnni yozgach, har bir zamonni tagiga chizing va nomini yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: beshta zamonning hammasi ma’noga to‘g‘ri kelgan bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda tugallangan zamon va tajribani o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz haqingizda taxminan 120 so‘zli matn yozing, kamida beshta zamon ishlating, har birining tagiga chizing va nomini yozing.

homework_uz: Hayotingiz haqida taxminan 120 so‘zli matn yozing. Unda kamida beshta turli zamon (masalan, past simple, present perfect, present simple, past continuous, going to) bo‘lsin. Har bir zamonning tagiga chizib, nomini yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir zamon ma’nosiga mos va vaqt belgisi bilan to‘g‘ri kelgan.

quiz.why_uz: Yesterday — tugagan aniq vaqt, shuning uchun past simple: I saw him yesterday.
For + muddat hozirgacha davom etsa, present perfect kerak: I've lived here for five years.

quiz.q: When I ___ home, I'll call you.
quiz.why_uz: When dan keyin kelasi zamon uchun hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi, will emas.

quiz.q: We ___ dinner when the phone rang.
quiz.why_uz: Telefon jiringlaganda jarayon bor edi — past continuous: were having.
Know — holat fe’li, odatda continuous bo‘lmaydi.
Film biz kelishimizdan oldin boshlangan — past perfect: had already started.
Yet bilan present perfect inkor: haven't finished.

quiz.q: Which word goes with the past simple?
quiz.why_uz: Ago doim past simple bilan ishlatiladi: three years ago.
Look! hozir ko‘rib turgan jarayonni bildiradi — present continuous.
Shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror — will: I'll answer it.
